title: One of the Coolest Shonen Jump Anime Is Getting a Live-Action Movie Next
content: One of the coolest Shonen Jump anime and manga franchises has announced it’s coming back with a brand new live-action movie next. It’s been a wild time to be a fan of anime as a decade or so ago, the thought of a live-action TV or movie adaptation would have been the worst news in the world.

title: King of the Hill Shares Emotional Lady Bird Tribute, Showrunner Explains New Replacement (Exclusive)
content: King of the Hill has returned to Hulu with a new season of the revival series, and the showrunner behind it all explained to ComicBook how they decided to pay tribute to Hank’s dog Ladybird and went about finding a new dog for the Hill family.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla vs. Kong Actress Kaylee Hottle Dies at 18
content: The deaf actress played deaf character Jia in the Godzilla vs. Kong film in 2021 and the Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire sequel in 2024. Hottle was nominated for Best Younger Performer in a Film for her role in Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire .
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Creator Takes Surprise Hiatus Due to Sudden Illness Amid Anime’s Uncertain Future
content: A major Shonen Jump series has announced a surprise hiatus through the Summer due to the creator’s poor health conditions, and fans are still waiting for the franchise to expand even wider with more of the anime. It can be tough to be a creator in Shueisha’s various Jump magazines.
author: ComicBook

title: Summer Time Rendering Manga Gets Live-Action Film in 2027
content: The official X/Twitter account for Yasuki Tanaka 's Summer Time Rendering suspense manga announced on Wednesday, July 22 (the same date the events in the series begin) that the franchise is getting a live-action film in 2027. Ken Ninomiya is directing the film.
author: ANN

title: The Live-Action Gundam Film Shares Major Update

title: Netflix, Crunchyroll Add More Episodes for Detective Conan Anime's 3rd Collection Featuring FBI on August 1
content: The "FBI Intervention" selection began streaming on May 1 with episodes that had never before been officially released in the U.S. The selection's specific episode numbers from the overall anime are 170-171, 226-227, 258-259, 277-278, 279-280, and 307-308.
